ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure and has curved arrows; according to the problem, ignore the arrows and read only the atom connections. The left central carbon is visibly connected to iodine I, is connected to two methyl groups, and is also connected to the adjacent central carbon on the right. The right central carbon is connected to two methyl groups and downward to an oxygen atom. This oxygen continues to connect to a carbonyl C(=O), and the carbonyl carbon is further connected to phenyl Ph, forming a benzoate fragment. Reasoning: Starting the SMILES from the left-end methyl gives a carbon fragment substituted by methyl and iodine, CC(C)(I), and this carbon is then connected to the adjacent carbon substituted by two methyl groups and a benzoyloxy group, C(C)(C)OC(=O)c1ccccc1. Therefore the corresponding SMILES is CC(C)(I)C(C)(C)OC(=O)c1ccccc1.

method.method_draft: First read the image as a connectivity graph, not as a mechanism: one carbon bears I and methyl groups, and the adjacent carbon bears two methyl groups and an O-C(=O)-phenyl ester substituent. Then write the chain in SMILES form by following that connectivity from the left alkyl end through the I-substituted carbon to the O-acylated carbon and out to the benzoyl group. The matching expression is CC(C)(I)C(C)(C)OC(=O)c1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，并带有弯箭头；按题意忽略箭头，只读取原子连接。可见左侧中心碳与碘 I 相连，并连有两个甲基，同时与右侧相邻中心碳相连。右侧中心碳连有两个甲基，并向下连到一个氧原子。该氧继续连到羰基 C(=O)，羰基碳再连到苯基 Ph，构成苯甲酸酯片段。推理：从左端甲基开始写，得到一个带甲基和碘取代的碳片段 CC(C)(I)，该碳再连到相邻的带两个甲基和苯甲酰氧基取代的碳 C(C)(C)OC(=O)c1ccccc1。因此对应的 SMILES 为 CC(C)(I)C(C)(C)OC(=O)c1ccccc1。

planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the drawn skeletal structure: identify the two adjacent quaternary carbon centers, the iodine substituent on the left/top center, the benzoate ester fragment O-C(=O)-Ph, and the methyl substituents. Ignore the curved arrows and treat them as non-structural annotations.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt directive 'choose the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows' to focus only on the molecular skeleton and to omit any mechanistic arrow information from the final string.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard chemistry notation rules for converting a line-bond drawing into SMILES: each unlabeled vertex is carbon, heteroatoms are explicit, and wedge/dash arrow-like mechanistic marks do not change connectivity when the prompt says to ignore arrows.
